correctness.rationale: A positive-definite Gram density, invertible orthant-area coordinates and exact determinant factorization imply the exact joint density. A uniform sinc expansion supplies O(eta^4) relative remainder, exact Dirichlet moments 4/21 and 29/55 give coefficients 1/168 and -7/330, sign symmetry accounts for all four maxima, and density-ratio control proves total-variation O(epsilon^2). A standalone test checks rational and geometric identities.
